name: Metaculus
description: Reputation-based forecasting platform with 3.2M+ predictions on science, technology, geopolitics, and AI. Uses community aggregation and calibration scoring to surface emergent collective intelligence about uncertain futures. Key venue for superforecasting research.
evaluation_method: Brier score, calibration metrics, reputation scoring
typical_sota_score: Brier ≈0.1–0.3 for top forecasters (varies by question)
notes: Free platform. One of the largest forecasting communities. Used extensively in superforecasting research and AI forecasting benchmarks.
